greeting.title: Robert Idarraga
greeting.intro: I design and build accessible, fast web products focused on user experience.

about.paragraph1: I am a Fullstack Web Developer with 3 years of experience building high-impact frontend and backend solutions. I mainly work with JavaScript/TypeScript, Angular, Ionic and Node.js, taking part in the full development cycle: technical design, implementation, testing, deployment and continuous improvement.
about.paragraph2: I have solid experience creating and managing APIs, integrating services and maintaining scalable architectures. I focus on performance, code quality and best practices to ensure stable, maintainable and easy-to-evolve applications.
about.paragraph3: I also have experience deploying applications to Play Store and managing their operations, as well as repository management with Git, collaborative development workflows and cloud solutions running on Azure. Additionally, I have knowledge of Flutter and Dart for cross-platform mobile development.
about.quote: I build software with a focus on quality, performance and real value for the end user.

experience.summary: Building web and mobile applications with Angular, Ionic and Node.js, focused on scalable architecture, performance and code quality. Experience creating and managing APIs, deploying apps to Play Store, version control with Git and operating solutions on Azure.
